title: Earthian
body:
# Earthian

Impact: 3

A literal celestial body personified

## Powers

### No Need to Breathe

You don't have lungs, thus no need to breathe.

### Rock Solid

You have natural armour points (much), but less max HP due to what the humans have done to you...

### Big and Bulky

You are much bigger than others, so you are slower at doing stuff and sink in water, can't ride vehicles, and can't elytra fly. You also exhaust much quicker.

### Global Warming

Fire melts your poles so it does more damage.

### Pacifist

You can only eat vegetables and do less damage with weapons.

### Overworldly

You get debuffs in The End and in The Nether.

### Kind Aura

You can send out a wave of positive energy that heals passive, friendly mobs and players. You also do the effects of a bonemeal.
